name: agent_files_init
title: Agent File Scaffold
description: Scaffold AGENT.md, AGENT_GOAL.md, AGENT_HARNESS.md, and AGENT_PROGRESS.md templates into a target directory under a strict four-file contract

target_dir.description: Directory where the four agent files will be scaffolded

mission.description: One- or two-sentence long-term mission statement written into AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read; must not include workflow preferences, current state, next steps, or transient objectives

objective.description: Concrete transient in-flight objective written into AGENT_PROGRESS.md. Must not define permanent mission, scope, policy, or success criteria. If omitted, the scaffolded AGENT_PROGRESS.md omits the Current Objective section entirely

overwrite.description: If true, existing files in target_dir are replaced; if false, only compatible existing files are recorded as skipped after hardened boundary-contract inspection, including current precedence, boundary-audit, neutral-scaffold, and dispatcher semantics
